title: Render --help/-h/help at every dispatch level from the capabilities catalog
diff_sketch: Intercept --help/-h/help tokens in cli.rs dispatch + family dispatchers before unknown-command errors; render human usage text (family: command list w/ usage lines; leaf: usage/flags/examples/limitations) from the existing contract catalog; exit 0; plain text to stdout.
risk: touches every dispatcher; catalog is single source so drift-safe
tests: help exits 0 at top/family/leaf; content includes usage line from catalog

title: Add triage mega-command (validate --strict + lint + counts + next actions in one call)
diff_sketch: New `triage <project> --json`: runs strict validation + lint, returns {ok, counts, errors, findingsBySeverity, topFindings (table steps only), next[]} with copy-paste next commands.
tests: triage on sales fixture: ok true, next[] non-empty, byte-deterministic

title: Catalog-driven did-you-mean for subcommands and per-command flags
diff_sketch: Levenshtein<=2 nearest across the current dispatch level (subcommand names from catalog; per-command flags from catalog flags[]); prepend "Did you mean `X`?" to existing hints.

title: Silence m.unbuffered_reuse on non-table let-steps; add stepKind
diff_sketch: Classify each step: lambda/function definition, scalar/record/list literal, table-producing. Only warn on table-producing (or unknown) steps; emit stepKind field on findings.
tests: fixture with fn+scalar reuse -> no finding; table reuse -> finding with stepKind

title: Version payload carries gitSha + buildTimestamp for stale-binary detection
diff_sketch: build.rs embeds GIT_SHA (git rev-parse, fallback "unknown") + BUILD_TIMESTAMP (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH-honoring); version + capabilities include them.
risk: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH honored to keep reproducible builds
tests: version --json has gitSha field; deterministic under pinned epoch

title: Add guid utility for TMDL lineageTags
diff_sketch: New `guid [--count N] --json` -> {"guids":[...]} lowercase v4; document intended use for lineageTag authoring.

title: desktop open/screenshot accept --enable-oracle flag in addition to env var
diff_sketch: Flag sets the same internal opt-in as POWERBI_DESKTOP_ORACLE=1; oracle_disabled hint names BOTH the env var and the flag.
risk: env var stays authoritative when set
tests: open --enable-oracle passes gate without env; hint mentions flag
